user.title: Connect to your Episode Response amp
user.description: Use the same login as the amp's web UI. The API refuses to talk until the factory password has been changed.

data_description.port: Default 8080 — changeable in the amp web UI.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the amp. Check IP/port and that it's on the same network.
error.default_password: The amp is still on its factory password. Log into its web UI, change the password, then try again.
error.locked_out: Too many bad password attempts — the amp has locked the account. Wait a bit or reboot it.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This amp is already set up.

data_description.volume_scale: The highest number the amp accepts for output volume. 100 on current firmware.
data_description.poll_interval: How often to re-read volume/mute/source. Also keeps the TCP session alive.
